candidate.subject: government
candidate.question: The Security Council of the United Nations Organization is made up of

options.C: the five permanent members and other members periodically elected
options.D: eleven member states elected by the General Assembly

candidate.explanation: The Security Council combines five permanent members with ten non-permanent members elected by the General Assembly for two-year terms. It is therefore neither a body of only permanent members nor one composed entirely of elected members.

candidate.question: In 1979, the Unity Party of Nigeria contested and won gubernatorial elections in

options.A: Lagos, Ogun, Imo, Oyo and Bendel
options.B: Lagos, Kwara, Oyo, Ogun and Benue
options.C: Lagos, Ogun, Oyo, Ondo and Bendel

candidate.explanation: The UPN won the governorships of Lagos, Ogun, Oyo, Ondo and Bendel. Its governors included Jakande, Onabanjo, Ige, Ajasin and Alli; Imo, Kwara and Benue were won by other parties.
